==Albanian==

===Etymology 1===
Theoretically from {{der|sq|sqj-pro|*kākta}}, of {{unc|sq|nocap=1}} origin; potentially akin to {{cog|lt|koktùs||disgusting}} via {{uder|sq|ine-pro|-}}. An older hypothesis connects it to {{cog|grc|κότος||rancor, grudge}}.<ref>{{R:sq:Orel:1998|page=193}}</ref>

====Adverb====
{{sq-adv}}

# [[worthlessly]]
# [[in vain]]

====Adjective====
{{head|sq|adjective}}

# [[worthless]]
# [[pointless]]

=====Derived terms=====
* {{l|sq|kotë}}

===Etymology 2===
From {{der|sq|sqj-pro|*kāta}}, from {{inh|sq|ine-pro|*(s)kh₃tos|*(s)kHtos|shade, shadow, darkness}}. Compare {{cog|sga|scáth||shadow}}, {{cog|grc|σκότος||darkness}}, {{cog|sa|छत्त्र||umbrella}}, {{cog|en|shadow}}.<ref>{{R:sq:Orel:1998|page=193}}</ref>

====Noun====
{{sq-noun|m}}

# [[darkness]]

==Dutch==

===Etymology===
From {{inh|nl|dum|cot}}, from {{inh|nl|odt|*kot}}, from {{inh|nl|gmw-pro|*kot}}, from {{inh|nl|gem-pro|*kutą||shed}}. Cognate with {{cog|en|cot|t=pen, coop}}, the feminine stem variant {{m+|dum|cote}} ({{m+|odt|kota}}) corresponds to {{cog|de|Kate|t=hut}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|nl|/kɔt/}}
* {{audio|nl|Nl-kot.ogg}}
* {{hyph|nl|kot}}
* {{rhymes|nl|ɔt|s=1}}

===Noun===
{{nl-noun|n|-en,-:en|+,-teke}}

# bad, [[ramshackle]] [[housing]]
#: {{uxi|nl|In wat voor een '''kot''' woont die!|What a shack she lives in!}}
# [[rudimentary]] building to store (garden) material
# {{lb|nl|Belgium}} student room
#: {{syn|nl|kamer|studentenkamer|studentenkot}}
#: {{uxi|nl|[[Leuven]]se '''koten''' [[afbranden|brandden]] [[vaak]] af [[in de jaren]] 90.|Student rooms in Louvain burned down often in the nineties.}}

====Related terms====
* {{l|nl|coterie}}
* {{l|de|katenspek}}
* {{l|nl|keuter}}

** {{desc|vic|kot|bor=1}} {{q|dated}}
